section.title: org.osgi.service.configurator
section.para: Configurator Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.

listitem.para: ConfiguratorConstants - Defines standard constants for the Configurator services.

section.title: public final class ConfiguratorConstants
section.para: Defines standard constants for the Configurator services.

section.title: public static final String CONFIGURATOR_BINARIES = "configurator.binaries"
section.para: Framework property specifying the directory to be used by the Configurator to store binary files.
If a value is specified, the Configurator will write all binaries to the given directory. Therefore the Configurator bundle needs read and write access to this directory.
If this property is not specified, the Configurator will store all binary files in its bundle private data area.

section.title: public static final String CONFIGURATOR_EXTENDER_NAME = "osgi.configurator"
section.para: The name of the extender capability attribute for the Configurator

section.title: public static final String CONFIGURATOR_INITIAL = "configurator.initial"
section.para: Framework property specifying initial configurations to be applied by the Configurator on startup.
If the value of this property starts with a '{' (ignoring leading whitespace) it is interpreted as JSON and directly feed into the Configurator.
Otherwise the value is interpreted as a comma separated list of URLs pointing to JSON documents.

section.title: public static final String CONFIGURATOR_SPECIFICATION_VERSION = "1.0"
section.para: The version of the extender capability for the Configurator specification

section.title: public static final String POLICY_DEFAULT = "default"
section.para: Value for defining the default policy.

section.title: public static final String POLICY_FORCE = "force"
section.para: Value for defining the force policy.

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_POLICY = ":configurator:policy"
section.para: Configuration property for the configuration policy.
Allowed values are POLICY_DEFAULT and POLICY_FORCE

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_PREFIX = ":configurator:"
section.para: Prefix to mark properties as input for the Configurator when processing a configuration resource.

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_RANKING = ":configurator:ranking"
section.para: Configuration property for the configuration ranking.
The value of this property must be convertible to a number.

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_RESOURCE_VERSION = ":configurator:resource-version"
section.para: Global property in the configuration resource specifying the version of the resource format.
Currently only version 1 is defined for the JSON format and therefore the only allowed value is 1 for this property. If this property is not specified, 1 is assumed.

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_SYMBOLIC_NAME = ":configurator:symbolic-name"
section.para: Global property in the configuration resource specifying the symbolic name of the configuration resource. If not specified the symbolic name of the bundle containing the resource is used. Mandatory for configuration resources that do not reside in a bundle

section.title: public static final String PROPERTY_VERSION = ":configurator:version"
section.para: Global property in the configuration resource specifying the version of the resource. If not specified the version of the bundle containing the resource is used. Mandatory for configuration resources that do not reside in a bundle.
